Sign up to the weekly update here: https://sendfox.com/farmvetfilms

I'm Kaz, a farm animal vet in the UK. This channel is my attempt to share with you what a farm vet gets up to, as well as to showcase some of the brilliant work done by our clients.

Hit subscribe and join me on my daily rounds as I cruise the beautiful Northumberland countryside!

Enquires to kaz.strycharczyk@bsfh.co.uk.
